parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
2:03 AM

Mummy ke birthday (Fri 30 Oct) ke liye rasmalai cake sabse safe aur special lagega. Ye 3 options bhi acche hain:

Rasmalai cake: halka meetha, desi swaad, almost sabko pasand aata hai
Chocolate truffle: classic, ghar mein sab khushi se khayenge
Fresh fruit cake: kam meetha aur halka, agar mummy zyada sweet nahi khati

Photo cake ya naam likhwana ho to wo bhi ho jata hai. Ek baat batao: mummy ko meetha kaisa pasand hai, zyada rich ya halka?

Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
2:04 AM

Mon 2 Nov isn't a public holiday in Mumbai as far as I know, so it should be a normal working day. I can't check live holiday lists here, so confirm with your bank or office if it matters. Diwali is around Sun 8 Nov.
